name: Inada Shuuya
source:
The missing friend. The central mystery of the story whose disappearance sets the plot in motion.
He was a target of bullying due to his intellect, which isolated him. He was kind enough to befriend Youan the yokai and give him a name, showing a thoughtful and friendly nature. He had a quiet crush on Kie.
